item.title: BYU standout receiver Parker Kingston charged with first-degree rape in Utah
item.description: Prosecutors in Utah have filed a first-degree felony rape charge against BYU standout wide receiver Parker Kingston, officials said Wednesday.

item.title: Asking Eric: He says no automatically
item.description: Dear Eric: I've been married for 37 years to a man who is everything most people dream of in a spouse except one. He automatically says “no” or disagrees with 98 percent of everything I say or suggest. I've learned not to ask questions that I know he will respond to in the negative. I've also asked him many times over the years to work on saying “yes” more.
